truth_boundary: N=1 derived-session diagnostics contextualize one local operating scale; synthetic truth and reference-oracle tests remain the correctness evidence; this is not reference-device validation.
storage_boundary: Derived gaze/pupil/capture records and summary reports only; no raw eye video or persisted eye-crop images are required or persisted by this bridge.

metrics.label: finite gaze fraction
metrics.interpretation: The pilot and synthetic domains use the same finite-gaze fraction; the clean N=1 session contextualizes clean-session examples without replacing dropout or low-light stress domains.

metrics.label: valid pupil fraction
metrics.interpretation: The local run shows whether the current capture path produced a usable pupil proxy; synthetic dropout domains remain stress tests.

metrics.label: sampling rate
metrics.interpretation: A webcam-rate local session contextualizes live-style tests and timestamp-jitter assumptions; it is not a hardware benchmark.

synthetic.display: synthetic sessions can be generated at chosen rates

metrics.label: sampling interval CV
metrics.interpretation: The coefficient of variation is a session-timing diagnostic used to sanity-check live-style jitter magnitudes.

metrics.label: maximum drift slope
metrics.interpretation: The pilot supplies one low-drift operating scale; synthetic head-drift cases deliberately probe harder conditions.

synthetic.display: head-drift domain is a stress test

metrics.label: held-out target RMS
metrics.interpretation: Held-out screen-target residual includes prompt following, calibration, webcam session effects, and user behavior; it is not iid landmark noise or gaze accuracy.

metrics.label: target acquisition latency
metrics.interpretation: UI/capture target-acquisition timing measures the local protocol loop, not physiological saccade latency.

metrics.label: saccade detection stress
metrics.interpretation: Synthetic truth and oracle comparisons, not the N=1 pilot, test event-detector correctness under known labels.

metrics.label: amplitude recovery MAE
metrics.interpretation: Amplitude MAE is defined only where synthetic truth labels exist; the pilot supplies operating-scale context, not truth labels.

metrics.label: amplitude model stability
metrics.interpretation: Bootstrap winner frequency describes ranking stability in the synthetic diagnostic report, not a biological population model.
